title: The Hermit's Cave
text: A holy hermit lives in a cave high above the road, up a path so steep it is nearly a ladder. Pilgrims leave bread at the bottom, heaps of it, mouldering. Few climb. The ones who come down again do not talk about what he said.

options.label: The wisest climbs to see him, eager to learn what keeps the others silent.

outcomes.text: He says three words, and they help, and they will not say what they were, not even to you.

options.label: Leave bread with the rest, and leave him his solitude.

outcomes.text: A small good thing, added to the mouldering pile.

options.label: The proudest climbs up to test him, certain no hermit can teach them anything.

outcomes.text: He sends them down humbled, and very quiet, and they do not talk about what he said.
